sub_graphs.title: Altair: Light Client Update Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of light client updates from reception through validation to application in the light client store

nodes.label: Light Client Store Initialized
nodes.description: LightClientStore has been bootstrapped with a trusted block root, current sync committee, and Merkle proof

nodes.label: Light Client Update Received
nodes.description: A LightClientUpdate message has been received from the P2P network or full node

nodes.label: Validate Light Client Update
nodes.description: Check all validation rules: slot ordering, sync committee participation threshold, Merkle branch verification, BLS aggregate signature verification

nodes.label: Update Passes Validation
nodes.description: The update has passed all validation checks and is eligible for application

nodes.label: Compare Against Best Update
nodes.description: Use is_better_update to compare this update against the current best_valid_update using the tiered ranking criteria

nodes.label: Apply Update to Store
nodes.description: Update finalized_header, optimistic_header, sync committees, and participation metrics in the LightClientStore

nodes.label: Light Client Store Updated
nodes.description: The store reflects the new finalized/optimistic headers and sync committee state

edges.label: Full node sends light client update
Check if this is the best update
Update meets application criteria (supermajority or force update)

external_entities.name: Full Node / Beacon API
external_entities.description: A full beacon chain node that produces and serves light client updates

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Light Client Update Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the detailed validation checks applied to incoming light client updates

nodes.label: Incoming Update Pending Validation
nodes.description: A LightClientUpdate has been received and needs validation

nodes.label: Verify Slot Ordering
nodes.description: Ensure finalized_slot <= attested_slot < signature_slot <= current_slot

nodes.label: Check Minimum Participation
nodes.description: Verify sync committee has at least MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS (1) signers

nodes.label: Verify Period Constraint
nodes.description: Ensure update does not skip sync committee periods; must be current or next period relative to store

nodes.label: Verify Merkle Branches
nodes.description: Validate finality_branch and next_sync_committee_branch against beacon state roots using is_valid_normalized_merkle_branch

nodes.label: Verify BLS Aggregate Signature
nodes.description: Verify the sync committee aggregate signature over the attested header using the appropriate fork domain

nodes.label: All Validation Checks Passed
nodes.description: The update is cryptographically valid and structurally sound

nodes.label: Validation Failed
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed; update is discarded

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Light Client Trust Model and Safety Thresholds
sub_graphs.description: Models the trust boundaries and safety mechanisms in the light client sync protocol

nodes.label: Trusted Block Root Established
nodes.description: User has obtained a trusted block root through external means (out-of-band verification)

nodes.label: Initialize Store from Bootstrap
nodes.description: Validate the LightClientBootstrap against the trusted root and establish the initial LightClientStore

nodes.label: Safety Threshold Active
nodes.description: The store tracks max_active_participants and computes safety_threshold as half the maximum seen

nodes.label: Evaluate Optimistic Header Safety
nodes.description: Accept optimistic header only if participation exceeds safety_threshold

nodes.label: Evaluate Finality Safety
nodes.description: Accept finalized header advancement only with 2/3 supermajority sync committee participation

nodes.label: Force Update on Timeout
nodes.description: If no finality progress within UPDATE_TIMEOUT (~27.3 hours), force-apply the best pending update to prevent liveness failure

nodes.label: Finalized Header Advanced
nodes.description: The finalized header in the store has been updated to a newer slot

edges.label: Attested header promoted to finalized for liveness

external_entities.name: External Trust Source
external_entities.description: The out-of-band mechanism by which the user obtains the initial trusted block root (e.g., social consensus, trusted website)

ambiguities.text: MIN_SYNC_COMMITTEE_PARTICIPANTS is set to 1, meaning a single validator signature is sufficient for a valid update. The security implications of this low threshold are not discussed.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the minimum of 1 is for liveness guarantees only. Actual security relies on the is_better_update ranking and the safety_threshold mechanism which requires higher participation for header advancement.

ambiguities.text: The force update mechanism 'promotes' the attested header to finalized when UPDATE_TIMEOUT elapses. The exact conditions under which this could lead to accepting a non-finalized header are not fully specified.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume force updates are a liveness trade-off that sacrifices strict finality guarantees. The best_valid_update still required cryptographic validity, so force updates can only promote headers that had valid sync committee signatures.

ambiguities.text: The is_valid_normalized_merkle_branch function 'allows leading zero hashes' but does not define what constitutes a valid sparse proof versus an invalid truncated proof.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume any Merkle branch where leading zeros correspond to empty subtrees in the beacon state is valid. The branch must still produce the correct root when computed.

implicit_assumptions.description: The initial trusted block root obtained by the user is correct and corresponds to a canonical chain block.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: An attacker providing a malicious trusted root could bootstrap the light client onto a forged chain, completely compromising all subsequent header validation.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control 2/3 or more of the sync committee validators to forge finality updates.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: With 2/3 sync committee control, an attacker could forge finality proofs pointing to an invalid chain, causing the light client to accept fraudulent state.

implicit_assumptions.description: The light client will receive at least one valid update within the UPDATE_TIMEOUT period under normal network conditions.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Persistent network partitioning could cause repeated force updates, potentially degrading the quality of the light client's finalized view.
